生料 → 熟料 → 水泥：CaCO₃(s) ═高温═ CaO(s) + CO₂↑: Raw meal → clinker → cement: CaCO₃(s) ═high temp═ CaO(s) + CO₂↑
煅烧在水泥回转窑中进行（教材原句）· 工艺数字为课件设定: Calcination takes place in a cement rotary kiln (textbook wording) · process numbers are lesson settings
教材原句就是这条线：黏土 + 石灰石「经混合、研磨后在水泥回转窑中煅烧」，再加石: The textbook's sentence is exactly this line: clay + limestone are "mixed, ground and then calcined in a cement rotary kiln", then gypsum is added and "ground to a fine powder".
前一段是磨、后一段也是磨，中间才是烧——所以水泥厂的磨机比窑多。: Grinding at the start and grinding at the end, with burning in the middle; that is why a cement plant has more mills than kilns.
熟料不是产品：水泥 = 熟料 + 石膏（+ 混合材）一起磨出来的粉。: Clinker is not the product: cement = the powder ground from clinker + gypsum (+ additives).
去掉生料制备与水泥磨：窑里进的是一堆粗块、出来的是熟料块，都到不了「水泥」。: Without raw meal preparation and the cement mill, coarse lumps go into the kiln and clinker lumps come out, and neither is "cement".
常考「水泥和混凝土的区别」：水泥是胶凝材料，加砂、碎石、水才成混凝土（教材原句）: Common exam point: the difference between cement and concrete. Cement is a binder; with sand, gravel and water it becomes concrete (textbook wording).
五个工段是一条「先磨、再烧、再磨」的线：生料制备 → 预热分解 → 回转窑 →: The five sections form a "grind, burn, grind again" line: raw meal preparation → preheating and precalcining → rotary kiln → grate cooler → cement mill; the real high-temperature reactions happen only in the rotary kiln.
为什么石灰石和黏土非要磨成粉、还要混匀了才进窑？: Why must limestone and clay be ground to powder and mixed evenly before going into the kiln?
把「生料磨细与均化」拨到粗料直入，看 f-CaO 和热耗怎么变: Switch "raw meal grinding and homogenizing" to coarse feed and watch f-CaO and heat consumption change
关掉磨机：f-CaO 从 0.75 % 升到 1.35 %、热耗 3100 →: Mill off: f-CaO rises from 0.75 % to 1.35 %, heat consumption 3100 → 3280 kJ/kg, kiln risk 0.10 → 0.25; turn it back on and it returns to 0.75 %.
石灰石 + 黏土 + 辅料 → 磨细均化 → 生料: Limestone + clay + correctives → ground and homogenized → raw meal
课件设定：细度不合格按 f-CaO +0.60 %、热耗 +180 kJ/kg: Lesson setting: off-spec fineness counted as f-CaO +0.60 % and heat consumption +180 kJ/kg
生料制备做两件事：磨细（比表面积够）+ 混匀（均化库把成分波动压下去）。: Raw meal preparation does two things: grinding fine (enough surface area) + mixing evenly (the homogenizing silo smooths out composition swings).
窑里的反应是固相/液相反应，靠颗粒接触，粗颗粒反应走不完。: The kiln reactions are solid/liquid-phase reactions that rely on particle contact; coarse particles cannot finish reacting.
f-CaO 升高不只是「烧得不好」，它遇水消解膨胀、直接影响安定性。: Rising f-CaO is not only "poor burning": it slakes and expands in contact with water, directly affecting soundness.
去掉生料制备：粗料进窑，窑再热也烧不透，f-CaO 高、热耗高。: Without raw meal preparation, coarse feed goes into the kiln, and however hot the kiln, it does not burn through: high f-CaO, high heat consumption.
常考「生料为什么要磨细混匀」：增大接触面积、稳定成分，保证煅烧均匀。: Common exam point: why raw meal must be ground fine and mixed evenly. To increase contact area and stabilize composition so calcination is uniform.
颗粒粗、成分不匀，同样的窑温也烧不透：大颗粒表面烧到了、芯里还没分解，CaO 就: With coarse particles and uneven composition, the same kiln temperature does not burn through: the surface of a big particle is burned while its core has not decomposed, so CaO is left free; this is the first source of f-CaO.
生料为什么不在窑里一把烧完，要先在塔上预热、还要先分解？: Why isn't raw meal burned all at once in the kiln? Why preheat it in the tower and decompose it first?
把分解炉出口温度从 880 拖到 780 ℃，看分解率和 f-CaO: Drag the precalciner outlet temperature from 880 to 780 ℃ and watch decomposition and f-CaO
分解炉 880 → 780 ℃：分解率 90.0 % → 45.0 %、f-Ca: Precalciner 880 → 780 ℃: decomposition 90.0 % → 45.0 %, f-CaO 0.75 → 2.33 %, heat consumption 3100 → 3172 kJ/kg.
分解炉出口 850–900 ℃ · 入窑分解率约 90 %（课件设定）: Precalciner outlet 850–900 ℃ · decomposition at kiln inlet about 90 % (lesson setting)
预热器里物料向下、热气自窑尾向上，逆流换热，出塔时物料已接近分解温度。: In the preheater material goes down and hot gas rises from the kiln inlet: counterflow heat exchange brings the material close to its decomposition temperature as it leaves the tower.
分解炉做的是 CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂，这一步吸热，放出的 CO₂ 是: The precalciner does CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂; this step is endothermic, and the CO₂ it releases is the bulk of cement's carbon emissions.
分解率每低一点，窑内的热负荷和 f-CaO 都跟着涨。: For every bit less decomposition, the kiln's heat load and f-CaO both rise.
去掉预热分解：全部在窑里烧，窑要长得多、热耗高得多，产量还低。: Without preheating and precalcining, everything burns in the kiln: the kiln must be much longer, heat consumption much higher and output lower.
常考「预热器和分解炉的作用」：先换热升温、再提前分解，把窑的负担挪到分解炉。: Common exam point: the role of the preheater and precalciner. Heat exchange first, then early decomposition, shifting the kiln's burden to the precalciner.
在 850–900 ℃ 的分解炉里先放掉 CO₂，入窑分解率能到 90 %：窑只: Releasing CO₂ first in the precalciner at 850–900 ℃ brings decomposition at the kiln inlet to 90 %: the kiln only has to burn the material until a liquid phase forms, saving output and heat; if decomposition drops, the kiln must do the precalciner's work.
回转窑为什么又斜又转？料和火到底谁往哪走？: Why is the rotary kiln tilted and turning? Which way do material and flame go?
窑已剖开：拖动视角，看物料带怎么走、热气箭头往哪指、四段温度怎么排: The kiln is cut open: drag the view to see how the material bed moves, where the hot gas arrows point and how the four temperature zones line up
剖开后：物料铺在筒体下方、随筒体翻动，沿窑轴从窑尾（冷端）走到窑头（热端）；火焰: Cut open: the material lies along the bottom of the shell and tumbles as it turns, moving along the axis from the kiln inlet (cold end) to the kiln outlet (hot end); the flame is at the outlet and hot gas flows the other way toward the inlet; the four zones run preheating 800–1000 ℃ < decomposition 1000–1300 ℃ < burning zone 1350–1450 ℃, and after the burning zone the cooling zone drops back to 1200–1300 ℃.
物料：窑尾 → 窑头 ；热气流：窑头 → 窑尾（逆流）: Material: inlet → outlet; hot gas: outlet → inlet (counterflow)
斜度 3.5 %、转速 3.5 r/min、四段温度见 facts B4（课件设: Slope 3.5 %, speed 3.5 r/min, four zone temperatures per facts B4 (lesson settings)
物料从窑尾进、窑头出；热气从窑头烧起来、向窑尾走，两者逆流。: Material enters at the kiln inlet and leaves at the outlet; hot gas starts at the outlet and travels toward the inlet, in counterflow.
筒体斜 3.5 %、每分钟转 3.5 圈，物料才一步步往前挪。: With a slope of 3.5 % and 3.5 turns per minute, the material moves forward step by step.
剖开后能看到四段：预热段、分解带、烧成带（1350–1450 ℃）、冷却带。: Cut open, four zones are visible: preheating, decomposition, burning (1350–1450 ℃) and cooling.
去掉斜度与转动：物料堆在一处，只有贴着火焰那一面过烧、其余欠烧。: Without slope and rotation the material piles in one place: the side facing the flame is overburned and the rest underburned.
常考「回转窑为什么要倾斜和旋转」：靠斜面与翻搅把物料连续送进高温带并充分换热。: Common exam point: why the rotary kiln is tilted and rotates. The slope and tumbling carry material continuously into the hot zone with thorough heat exchange.
斜度让物料沿轴向前进，转动把物料带起来翻搅——这样物料才能连续地从冷端走到热端，: The slope moves material along the axis, and rotation lifts and tumbles it; that way it travels continuously from cold end to hot end while exchanging heat thoroughly with the counterflowing hot gas.
窑温到底要多高？低一点省煤，为什么不行？: How hot must the kiln be? A bit cooler saves coal, so why not?
把烧成带温度从 1420 拖到 1350 ℃，看 f-CaO 怎么变: Drag the burning zone temperature from 1420 to 1350 ℃ and watch f-CaO change
窑温 1420 → 1350 ℃：f-CaO 0.75 % → 2.15 %（超: Kiln 1420 → 1350 ℃: f-CaO 0.75 % → 2.15 % (above the 1.5 % target line); heat consumption still reads 3100 kJ/kg (in this lesson's model heat consumption does not vary with kiln temperature, a simplification); pull back to 1420 ℃ and it returns to 0.75 %.
烧成带 1350–1450 ℃ · 液相约 1280 ℃ 以上出现: Burning zone 1350–1450 ℃ · liquid phase appears above about 1280 ℃
C₃S 是水泥早期强度的主力，它在液相里生成（液相约 1280 ℃ 以上出现，1: C₃S is the main source of cement's early strength and forms in the liquid phase (which appears above about 1280 ℃, in sufficient amount only at 1350–1450 ℃), so the burning zone temperature is a hard threshold.
温度不够不是「稍微差一点」，f-CaO 会成倍涨（1350 ℃ 时 2.15 %: Not hot enough is not "slightly off": f-CaO multiplies (2.15 % at 1350 ℃).
温度也不能无限高：1480 ℃ 以上液相过多，窑皮挂不住、结圈红窑。: The temperature cannot be unlimited either: above 1480 ℃ there is too much liquid phase, the coating cannot hold, rings form and the shell glows red.
去掉这一课：学生只会背「高温煅烧」，不知道高温是为了出液相、以及低一点的代价。: Without this lesson students only recite "high-temperature calcination", not knowing the heat is for forming a liquid phase or what a lower temperature costs.
常考「烧成带温度不足的后果」：C₃S 生成不足、f-CaO 升高、安定性不良。: Common exam point: consequences of too low a burning zone temperature. Too little C₃S, higher f-CaO, poor soundness.
烧成带要 1350–1450 ℃：液相约 1280 ℃ 以上就出现，但要到 13: The burning zone needs 1350–1450 ℃: liquid phase appears above about 1280 ℃, but only at 1350–1450 ℃ is there enough of it for C₂S to combine with CaO into C₃S in quantity; too cool, and CaO is left free, raising f-CaO and spoiling soundness.
熟料出窑一千三百度，为什么要抢着把它吹冷？: Clinker leaves the kiln at 1300 degrees. Why the rush to blow it cold?
把篦冷机停掉，看热耗和 CO₂ 排放怎么变: Stop the grate cooler and watch heat consumption and CO₂ emissions change
Grate cooler off: heat consumption 3100 → 3360 kJ/kg, CO₂ 0.80 → 0.83 kg per kg of clinker, kiln risk 0.10 → 0.20; the clinker cools slowly, the secondary air temperature drops and the kiln flame becomes unstable.
回收二次风约 1000 ℃ 回窑（课件设定）: Secondary air at about 1000 ℃ returned to the kiln (lesson setting)
篦冷机不是「放凉」，是换热器：冷风穿过料层，变成 1000 ℃ 上下的二次风回窑: The grate cooler is not "letting it cool" but a heat exchanger: cold air passes through the clinker bed and becomes secondary air of around 1000 ℃ returning to the kiln.
慢冷会让 C₃S 分解、活性掉，熟料发暗、易粉化。: Slow cooling lets C₃S decompose and lose activity; the clinker darkens and dusts easily.
停篦冷机不只是热耗涨，收尘和窑头火焰也跟着不稳。: Stopping the grate cooler does not only raise heat consumption; dust collection and the kiln flame also become unstable.
去掉急冷：热耗涨、CO₂ 涨，熟料活性还差。: Without quenching, heat consumption and CO₂ rise, and clinker activity is worse.
常考「熟料为什么要急冷」：保住 C₃S 与玻璃相、回收热量。: Common exam point: why clinker is quenched. To preserve C₃S and the glass phase, and to recover heat.
急冷有两个好处：一是把 C₃S 和玻璃相「冻」住，不让它转成没活性的晶型；二是把: Quenching has two benefits: it "freezes" C₃S and the glass phase so they do not turn into inactive crystal forms, and it turns the clinker's heat into secondary air for the kiln, saving heat directly.
石膏既不是石头也不是燃料，为什么非加不可？加多加少各会怎样？: Gypsum is neither aggregate nor fuel. Why must it be added? What happens with more or less?
把石膏掺量从 4.0 % 拖到 0.5 %，看初凝时间掉到多少: Drag the gypsum dosage from 4.0 % to 0.5 % and see how far the initial set time falls
石膏 4.0 → 0.5 %：初凝时间 148 → 36 min（低于 45 m: Gypsum 4.0 → 0.5 %: initial set 148 → 36 min (below the 45 min minimum: flash set); at 8 % SO₃ is 3.72 %, above the 3.5 % limit (initial set is also stretched to 276 min, only as side evidence, not as an upper limit).
石膏掺量 3.0–5.0 % · 初凝 ≥ 45 min（GB 175-2023: Gypsum dosage 3.0–5.0 % · initial set ≥ 45 min (GB 175-2023) · SO₃ ≤ 3.5 % (GB 175-2007 basis)
少了闪凝 36 min: Too little: flash set at 36 min
教材原句：「加入适量石膏调节水泥硬化速率」——石膏加在磨机里，不随生料进窑。: Textbook wording: "add an appropriate amount of gypsum to regulate the hardening rate of cement"; gypsum is added in the mill, not fed into the kiln with the raw meal.
少了闪凝（36 min 就凝，来不及施工），多了 SO₃ 超限、可能膨胀。: Too little and it flash-sets (setting in 36 min, no time to place it); too much and SO₃ exceeds the limit and may cause expansion.
「适量」是算出来的窗口：初凝 ≥ 45 min 卡下限，SO₃ ≤ 3.5 %: "Appropriate" is a calculated window: initial set ≥ 45 min sets the lower bound and SO₃ ≤ 3.5 % the upper bound (390 min is the limit for final set, not initial set).
去掉石膏：水泥一拌就凝，工地上根本来不及浇。: Without gypsum, cement sets as soon as it is mixed, with no time to pour it on site.
常考「水泥中加石膏的作用」：调节凝结时间（缓凝），不是提供强度。: Common exam point: the role of gypsum in cement. It regulates setting time (retards setting); it does not provide strength.
石膏是调凝剂：它和 C₃A 的水化产物生成钙矾石，把 C₃A 包住、拖慢凝结。少: Gypsum is a set regulator: it forms ettringite with the hydration products of C₃A, coating C₃A and slowing setting. Too little causes flash set, too much exceeds the SO₃ limit; the "appropriate amount of gypsum" in the textbook is exactly this window.
f-CaO、初凝、SO₃、热耗同时卡住时，你先动哪一个？: When f-CaO, initial set, SO₃ and heat consumption are all constrained, which do you move first?
把 f-CaO 压到 ≤ 1.5 %、初凝 ≥ 45 min、SO₃ ≤ 3.5: Bring f-CaO to ≤ 1.5 %, initial set to ≥ 45 min, SO₃ to ≤ 3.5 % and heat consumption to ≤ 3400 kJ/kg, and hold for 15 s

f-CaO ≤ 1.5 % · 初凝 ≥ 45 min · SO₃ ≤ 3.5: f-CaO ≤ 1.5 % · initial set ≥ 45 min · SO₃ ≤ 3.5 % · heat ≤ 3400 kJ/kg · decomposition ≥ 85 %

常考「为什么工业窑温取 1350–1450 ℃ 而不是更高」：够出液相生成 C₃: Common exam point: why industrial kilns run at 1350–1450 ℃ and not hotter. That is enough to form a liquid phase and C₃S; hotter causes rings, coating collapse and higher heat consumption.

看熟料颜色、f-CaO 化验与窑电流判断烧成: Judge burning by clinker color, f-CaO tests and kiln drive current
这条链要记住：窑温低 → 液相不足 → C₃S 少 → f-CaO 高 → 安定: Remember this chain: cold kiln → too little liquid phase → little C₃S → high f-CaO → poor soundness. The coal you saved has to be paid back by reprocessing.

窑温这条账的上限不是算出来的，是窑皮和耐火砖给出的：越过 1480 ℃ 就要用停: The upper limit of the kiln temperature account is not calculated but set by the coating and refractory bricks: go past 1480 ℃ and you pay with a kiln stop and relining.
本课目标：说清「先磨、再烧、再磨」这条线，看懂窑温与 f-CaO 的账、分解炉分: Lesson goal: explain the "grind, burn, grind again" line, and understand the accounts of kiln temperature and f-CaO, the precalciner's share, and the "not too much, not too little" window for gypsum.
教材里普通硅酸盐水泥的原料是: In the textbook, the raw materials of ordinary Portland cement are
纯碱、石灰石和石英砂: Soda ash, limestone and quartz sand
黏土和石灰石（加适量石膏调凝）: Clay and limestone (with an appropriate amount of gypsum to regulate setting)
人教必修2 印刷页 21 原句：「普通硅酸盐水泥的生产以黏土和石灰石为主要原料…: PEP Compulsory Book 2, printed page 21: "Ordinary Portland cement is produced mainly from clay and limestone… an appropriate amount of gypsum is added to regulate the hardening rate, and it is ground to a fine powder". Soda ash + limestone + quartz sand are the raw materials of glass.
水泥磨里加石膏的作用是: Gypsum is added in the cement mill to
调节凝结时间（缓凝），防止闪凝: Regulate setting time (retard setting) and prevent flash set
石膏与 C₃A 的水化产物生成钙矾石，把 C₃A 包住、拖慢凝结。少了闪凝（本课: Gypsum forms ettringite with the hydration products of C₃A, coating C₃A and slowing setting. Too little causes flash set (in this lesson's model initial set is only 36 min at 0.5 %), too much exceeds the SO₃ limit.
生料要磨细混匀，主要是因为: Raw meal must be ground fine and mixed evenly mainly because
颗粒细、成分匀，窑里才烧得透，f-CaO 才不会高: Fine particles and uniform composition let the kiln burn it through, keeping f-CaO low
窑内反应靠颗粒接触；粗颗粒表面烧到了、芯里还没分解，CaO 游离留下，f-CaO: Kiln reactions rely on particle contact; the surface of a coarse particle burns while its core has not decomposed, so CaO is left free, raising f-CaO and spoiling soundness.
分解炉里发生的主要反应是: The main reaction in the precalciner is
分解炉在 850–900 ℃ 把 CaCO₃ 分解成 CaO 并放出 CO₂（吸: At 850–900 ℃ the precalciner decomposes CaCO₃ into CaO and releases CO₂ (endothermic); decomposition at the kiln inlet can reach 90 %, leaving the kiln only the sintering.
回转窑里物料和热气流的方向是: In the rotary kiln the directions of material and hot gas are
物料窑尾→窑头，热气窑头→窑尾（逆流）: Material inlet → outlet, hot gas outlet → inlet (counterflow)
物料窑头→窑尾，热气窑尾→窑头: Material outlet → inlet, hot gas inlet → outlet
物料从窑尾（冷端）进、往窑头（热端）出；燃烧器在窑头，热气流反向朝窑尾走，两者逆: Material enters at the kiln inlet (cold end) and leaves at the outlet (hot end); the burner is at the outlet and hot gas flows back toward the inlet, exchanging heat in counterflow.
烧成带温度不足会直接导致: Too low a burning zone temperature directly causes
C₃S 生成不足、f-CaO 升高: Too little C₃S and higher f-CaO
液相量不足，C₂S 与 CaO 结合成 C₃S 的反应走不动，CaO 以游离态留: With too little liquid phase, the reaction combining C₂S with CaO into C₃S stalls and CaO is left free (in this lesson's model f-CaO is 2.15 % at 1350 ℃).
熟料出窑要急冷（篦冷机），原因是: Clinker leaving the kiln is quenched (grate cooler) because
保住 C₃S 与活性，同时把热量变成二次风回收: It preserves C₃S and activity, and recovers heat as secondary air
急冷避免 C₃S 分解、活性下降；同时冷风穿过料层变成约 1000 ℃ 的二次风: Quenching keeps C₃S from decomposing and losing activity; meanwhile cold air passing through the bed becomes secondary air of about 1000 ℃ for the kiln, saving heat directly.
工业上把烧成带温度控制在 1350–1450 ℃，而不是越高越好，因为: Industry keeps the burning zone at 1350–1450 ℃ rather than as hot as possible because
窑温越高 f-CaO 越高: The hotter the kiln, the higher the f-CaO
够出液相生成 C₃S 即可，再高就结圈、窑皮垮、热耗涨: Enough to form a liquid phase and C₃S is all that is needed; hotter causes rings, coating collapse and higher heat consumption
窑温与熟料质量无关: Kiln temperature has nothing to do with clinker quality
窑温高了初凝会变短: A hotter kiln shortens initial set
液相约 1280 ℃ 以上出现，1350–1450 ℃ 液相量才够生成 C₃S；: Liquid phase appears above about 1280 ℃, and only at 1350–1450 ℃ is there enough to form C₃S; above 1480 ℃ there is too much liquid, the coating cannot hold, rings form and the shell glows red.
